result:
Done. Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest.java` (JUnit 5, matching the project's existing tests), covering:

- Initial state (`UNDEFINED` last char, zero position/line/bytes)
- `getPosition()` tracking for single-char and bulk reads, including the EOF-decrements-position quirk on bulk EOF reads
- Zero-length `read()` short-circuit that consumes nothing
- `peek()` not advancing state, including at EOF
- `getLineNumber()` semantics across chars/CRLF/EOF
- `readLine()` on empty input, no trailing terminator, and CRLF handling
- `close()` setting last char to EOF and blocking further reads
- `mark()`/`reset()` restoring line number, position, last char, and bytes-read
- Byte-tracking via `CharsetEncoder`: ASCII, multi-byte, and surrogate-pair chars, plus the `CharacterCodingException` thrown on an unpaired low surrogate

All 17 test methods pass via `./_tools/test.sh`, and the full suite still runs clean.
